name: Remitly
description: Remitly is a regulated cross-border financial-services platform for personal remittances and business payments. Customers use its web and mobile products to send money internationally, pay contractors and suppliers, receive funds, and track transfers across supported corridors and delivery methods.
agentUseSummary: Remitly is visible as an enterprise-review preview only. Relay will not collect a Remitly password, browser session, access token, payment credential, or identity-verification data, and no agent action is callable until Remitly approves a supported partner API contract and authorization lifecycle for Relay.

capabilities.label: Read approved partner data
capabilities.description: After enterprise approval, expose only the provider-approved non-mutating corridor, quote, and exact transfer-status surface documented in Relay's signed partner contract.

blocked.label: Connect before enterprise approval
blocked.description: Relay has no current Remitly partner contract, approved application, production credentials, sandbox tenant, authorization lifecycle, permitted operation list, or compliance allocation.

blocked.label: Collect customer credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask customers for a Remitly password, browser session, bearer token, card or bank credential, identity document, tax identifier, or verification response as a substitute for provider-approved authorization.

blocked.label: Run Remitly API actions
blocked.description: No quote, corridor, recipient, transfer, payment, payout, account, wallet, identity, or status API action can run while enterprise review is pending.

blocked.label: Money movement unavailable
blocked.description: Creating, funding, submitting, changing, cancelling, refunding, receiving, or otherwise controlling transfers and payouts remains outside Relay's planned read-only V1 even after partner approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Enterprise review pending
approvalProfiles.description: Agent actions remain unavailable until Remitly approves Relay's partner integration and engineering implements and validates the exact read-only contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Remitly approves Relay and Relay implements the contracted read-only Railway broker.
No Hermes tools are callable until Remitly approves Relay and Relay implements the contracted read-only Railway broker.

providerSetup.blocker: Remitly has publicly described Remitly for Developers as an enterprise remittance-as-a-service API, but its current public site provides customer and business-account onboarding plus affiliate and business partner applications rather than current API documentation, self-service developer credentials, OAuth scopes, a sandbox, or a distributable customer authorization contract. Relay has no signed enterprise agreement, compliance allocation, approved operations, credentials, representative tenant, or test corridor.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Relay business and compliance owner must contact Remitly's enterprise partnership team and obtain a current API contract, supported jurisdictions and corridors, regulatory and KYC responsibilities, end-user authorization and revocation lifecycle, permitted read-only operations, data handling and retention terms, rate limits, webhook rules, sandbox tenant, representative test identities, and production onboarding terms. Engineering can then design the smallest read-only corridor, quote, and exact transfer-status V1, implement a fixed-origin Railway broker, and validate authorization, redaction, bounds, rate limits, disconnect, revocation, and post-disconnect denial in staging. Money movement remains excluded.

evidence.supports: Remitly's current partner program offers affiliate and business partnership applications and promotional resources; it does not publish API credentials, scopes, sandbox access, or a customer authorization flow.

Remitly Business currently documents verified account onboarding, recipient setup, bulk payments, send-by-link, transfer tracking, and international business payments through Remitly's own product rather than a customer API credential.
Remitly's official filing describes Remitly for Developers as a remittance-as-a-service enterprise offering that integrates businesses with its global payment and compliance network through APIs.
Remitly's official partnership announcement describes its developer offering as a company-level integration for cross-border payments and locally relevant payout options.
Remitly describes regulated personal and business cross-border payment products whose availability varies by jurisdiction and law.
